page.title: Interview coaching workspace
page.subtitle: Review past interviews or run voice mock sessions for roles you've applied to. Every session is archived per application so you can track improvement over time.
page.emptyBody: Apply to roles from <jobs>Jobs</jobs> first, then return here for interview review and mock practice.

review.intro: Upload a recorded interview for this role. The coach transcribes, summarizes, scores key dimensions, and suggests improvements — tailored to <role>{{jobTitle}}</role> (demo, no server). Each upload is archived.
review.analysisFailed: Analysis failed. Please try another file.

validate.notAudio: Please upload an audio file (MP3, WAV, M4A, or WebM).
validate.tooLarge: File is too large for this demo (max 25 MB).

mock.intro: Practice a live mock interview for <role>{{jobTitle}}</role>. The AI coach speaks questions aloud; record your voice answers. After {{count}} prompts you receive scored feedback. Each session is archived (demo — browser speech APIs).
mock.voiceLimited: Voice input/output may be limited in this browser. Use Chrome or Edge for the full experience.
mock.question: Q {{current}}/{{total}}

errors.voiceUnsupported: Voice coaching requires speech synthesis and recognition (Chrome or Edge recommended).
errors.startFailed: Could not start the mock interview. Try again.
errors.notAllowed: Microphone access is blocked. Allow mic permission for this site in your browser, then tap record again.
errors.serviceNotAllowed: Speech recognition is blocked. Allow mic permission for this site, then tap record again.
errors.audioCapture: No microphone was found. Connect a mic and try again.
errors.noSpeech: No speech was detected. Speak clearly into your mic, then tap record again.
errors.network: Speech recognition needs an internet connection (Chrome streams the audio to Google to transcribe).
errors.aborted: Recording was interrupted. Tap record to try again.
errors.recordFailedGeneric: Recording failed ({{error}}). Voice answers need Chrome or Edge with microphone access.
errors.startRecordFailed: Could not start recording. Check that your browser allows microphone access for this site (Chrome or Edge recommended).
errors.noSpeechSubmit: No speech detected. Try speaking again or type is not supported in this demo.
errors.noSession: Mock interview session was not created. Start again.
errors.submitFailed: Could not submit your answer. Try again.
